lyrics:
[Intro: sequenced synth stabs, techno kick, guitar riff enters]

[Verse 1: deep male voice, one word at a time]
Du
Du fragst
Du fragst mich
Du fragst mich, und ich klicke

[Chorus: full riff, gang shout]
Ich stimme zu (ja!)
Ich stimme zu (ja!)
Ich stimme zu
Habe ich eine Stimme?

[Verse 2: voice lower, synths answering]
Willst du alles wissen, wo ich bin, was ich will?
Willst du alles lesen, was ich schreibe, bis ich still bin?

[Chorus: full riff, gang shout]
Ich stimme zu (ja!)
Ich stimme zu (ja!)
Ich stimme zu
Habe ich eine Stimme?

[Bridge: guitars drop out, choir pad, whispered]
Akzeptieren. Akzeptieren.
Alle akzeptieren.

[Final Chorus: heaviest, the answer changes]
Ich stimme zu (nein!)
Ich stimme zu (nein!)
Ich stimme nicht zu
Ich habe eine Stimme

[Outro: riff stops dead, one synth note]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 125 BPM, 4/4, E minor. A heavy, mechanical march, half techno and half metal.

VOICE: Male bass-baritone, German, deep and dry with rolled Rs. The verse is delivered one word at a time. A gang of men shouts the answers. The bridge is whispered. No singing in the usual sense.

INSTRUMENTS: Down-tuned, palm-muted guitars playing one staccato riff, a four-on-the-floor techno kick with a gated snare, sequenced sawtooth synth stabs, a deep synth bass doubling the guitars, a male choir pad in the bridge.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, synth stabs then riff. 0:22 Verse 1. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2. 1:28 Chorus 2. 1:50 Bridge, whispered. 2:14 Final chorus, 'nein'. 2:50 Outro, dead stop, one note to 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1990s industrial metal: huge, dry and precise, guitars and kick locked together, vocal up front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The crowd's 'ja!' turning to 'nein!' at 2:14.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original refuses a wedding vow. This refuses the consent box: a small word clicked a thousand times a year, until one day he reads it. Translation of the chorus: I agree. Do I have a voice?

EMOTIONAL ARC: Obedient, uneasy, cornered, refusing.
